+++
title = "Before your call"
description = "Warning signs of a fake job interview and what to do instead, before you install or run anything."
checklist = true
+++

Fake job interviews have become a common way to infect developers. A recruiter offers a role, often in web3. Shortly before the call they send a link to a meeting app you do not know, or a coding test to run. The app or the test installs an info-stealer.

An info-stealer takes browser sessions, saved passwords, crypto wallet extensions, SSH keys and Telegram sessions.

Check the points below before you join a call or run code from someone you do not know.
